role.description: The role of the user in the app

callsign_verified.description: Whether the user has a verified, active GMRS callsign. Enforced by RLS on protected entities and by the requireVerifiedCallsign backend guard. Admins bypass this check.

license_number.description: FCC FRN (or equivalent) for the member's verified callsign.

license_expiry.description: FCC license expiration date from the ULS lookup. Used by the dashboard to show a renewal warning banner when expiry approaches.

license_service.description: Which radio service the member's verified primary callsign belongs to: GMRS or HAM (amateur radio). Empty on older accounts, which are treated as GMRS.

license_country.description: Country associated with the verified amateur-radio or GMRS callsign.

verification_source.description: Provider used for the most recent callsign verification, such as FCC/OpenCallbook, HamDB, or HamQTH.

verification_method.description: Verification method used for the most recent callsign check, such as official_fcc or international_callbook.

last_callsign_check.description: When the callsign verification status was last checked against the available license/callbook verification providers.

account_status.description: Administrative account status. Callsign-restricted accounts may access only their profile and callsign management until they add or verify a valid GMRS callsign. Suspended accounts are denied access app-wide. Investigation accounts are flagged for admin review and blocked from protected actions. Deleted accounts have had all user data removed and are deactivated.

last_active.description: ISO timestamp of the user's last activity, updated via a heartbeat while the user is online. Used for online/offline presence.

show_online_status.description: Whether the user's online/last-active status is visible to other members. Admins can always see it for moderation.

email_notifications.description: Master switch for all email notifications. Turn off to stop every email.

email_announcements.description: Receive admin broadcasts and site-wide announcements by email.

email_forum_replies.description: Receive an email when someone replies to your forum post.

email_messages.description: Receive an email when another member sends you a direct message.

email_access_requests.description: Receive an email when a member requests access to your closed repeater.

sound_notifications.description: Play a sound chime in-app for new notifications and messages while the app is open.

permissions.description: JSON object of effective permission keys to booleans. Computed from the user's role permissions plus individual overrides. Updated automatically when role permissions or overrides change.

dev_api_agreed.description: Whether this account has agreed to the Developer API Terms. Required, and checked server-side, before any API key can be created -- see api-key-manage's create action.

dev_api_agreed_at.description: When the account agreed to the Developer API Terms.

dev_api_agreed_version.description: Which version of the Developer API Terms was agreed to (see DEV_API_TERMS_VERSION), for re-prompting if the terms change materially.
